name: integration-directory
description: Integrations hub directory: eyebrow, H2 with a gradient slice and lede over a Categories radio list (left; a scrollable chip row on tablets and phones), a search field and a paginated three-column grid of logo cards (logo, name as the card link, indigo category tag, three-line description, Learn More row), with Previous / numbered pages / Next under it. Every card is server-rendered; behaviour.js adds the category filter, debounced live search over name, tag and description, 12-per-page pagination, an aria-live result count, the empty state, a card-shuffle animation on every filter, search or page change (Web Animations on transform/opacity; instant under reduced motion) and ?category= / ?q= in the address bar. Without JS every card shows. Figma: Desktop - Integrations > Features Section (7310:158798).

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores; starts with a letter).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading, e.g. INTEGRATION DIRECTORY.

title.description: Section heading (h2). Line breaks are kept.

title_accent.description: The part of the title painted with the brand gradient; must appear verbatim in title, e.g. Find the right connection.

categories_label.description: Heading of the category list (the radio group's legend). Hidden visually on tablets and phones, where the categories become a chip row.

categories.description: Filter options, in order. Each: key (matches an item's group; 'all' shows every card) and label. An 'all' option is added first when missing; categories no card belongs to are left out. Empty hides the filter.

search_label.description: Accessible name of the search field.

search_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the search field. Empty hides the search field.

link_label.description: Text of the arrow row at the foot of every card that has a url (decoration: the whole card is the link).

per_page.description: Cards per page (1-60). 0 turns pagination off.

status_text.description: Screen-reader announcement after a filter, search or page change. {from}, {to}, {total} (cards matching), {page}, {pages}.

empty_text.description: Shown (and announced) when the filter and search leave no card.

empty_link_label.description: Link under the empty message, e.g. Talk to our team about a custom connection. Renders only with empty_link_url.

empty_link_url.description: Destination of the empty-state link (page, #anchor, http(s), mailto: or tel:).

reset_label.description: Button in the empty state that clears the search and the category.

page_label.description: Compact page indicator on phones, and the accessible name pattern of the numbered buttons ({page}, {pages}).

url_sync.description: Mirror the chosen category and the search in the address bar (?category=…&q=…) so a filtered view can be shared, and restore them on load.

layout.description: default: the Integrations hub directory. compare: the Compare hub's Comparison Directory (Figma 7333:173384): eyebrow and a 20px heading on the left with the search field beside them, three columns of 280px logo cards whose name keeps its line breaks (Asset Panda Pro / vs. / X) over a View Comparison row, then the pager. compare-band: the same cards in a centred band (eyebrow, H2, lede over four columns, Figma 7379:185289) on a grey-to-white fade, usually without search or pager. In both compare layouts icon_w/icon_h are the logo's display size (Figma's): it shrinks to fit 180 x 64 but never grows.

items.description: Integrations, in display order. Each: name (required; the card heading and link text), url (card link), icon (logo URL; SVG or WebP), icon_w and icon_h (the logo's intrinsic size; SVG viewBox units are fine; recommended, they size the logo box), icon_crop ([x, y, w, h] in those units: the part of a padded logo canvas to show, needs icon_w/icon_h), tag (small indigo label under the name), group (category key, or several separated by commas) and description (clamped to three lines).
